svg.title: A 30-minute appointment with 10-minute buffers
svg.desc: A proportional time interval: a 10-minute buffer before, a 30-minute appointment, and a 10-minute buffer after. The appointment runs from 10:00 to 10:30 in this example; the full reserved interval runs from 09:50 to 10:40 and measures 50 minutes. Diagonal hatching identifies the two buffer intervals.
svg.metadata: Mode: conceptual diagram. Scale: 7.2 SVG units per minute. Horizontal widths 72, 216, 72 represent durations 10, 30, 10 minutes. H1 hatching means buffer time, not material. Example times only; no product behavior is asserted. References: Plotter K07 interval composition and P00 line hierarchy. All forms are transparent.
